prompt_markdown: The pantry is adding a script that decides how many parcels each family gets. You have an AI coding tool.
Which part should stay your decision, not the tool's?
hint: A rule that decides what people receive is a decision you must be able to explain.

options.text: Choosing clear names for the variables in the script.
Deciding how many parcels each family size receives.
Laying out the printed slip so it is easy to read.
Writing a first draft of the lines that read input.
